feedback.end: Ducks have webbed feet to help them paddle through the water. Their waterproof feathers also keep them dry.
Dragonflies live in the water until they are fully grown. Once they are adults, they catch and eat other insects while still flying.
Frogs are amphibious animals because they live in the water and on land. They lay their eggs, called frogspawn, in ponds.
Water lily leaves and flowers float on the surface to get more sunlight. They need sunlight to make their food.

atoms.a: Ponds are filled by streams, rainfall and hoses.
We can find pond habitats all over the UK.
Pond habitats are home to many different animals and plants.
